name: Luna
quote: Piece together the fragments of destiny to recreate the pure moonlight.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. A good beginning brings good fortune, you know~

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Professor, you've been so lively of late! Let me see... your brow is noble and upright—Looks like good things are in store for you!

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: It's dinnertime! Eh? My tummy's rumbling? As if! That's not ladylike at all!

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Honestly, I don't even need to do a reading to know you're still working instead of resting. I guess I'll just have to help you out, then.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Fortune-telling is the bridge between the diviner and the seeker. Therefore, a fortune-teller needs to do their best to learn about the outcome that the client wants. I've always been serious when it comes to fortune-telling.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Now, what kind of fortune-telling would you like to try today, Professor? The crystal ball, the runes, the tarot, or the Four Pillars of Destiny? As long as it's related to fortune-telling, I know all about it! Oh? Then why don't I predict which method you'll pick, Professor?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Hm? Are you asleep, Professor? Hehe, I wonder if you'll come to me for a dream interpretation when you wake up... Zzzzz...

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Yelena and I use completely different methods when fortune-telling... But we both believe fortune-telling gives people hope and strength. That said, my professional skills are just a bit better~

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Can we go out together, Professor? It seems there's a special omen about the place you're going to.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Would you like me to do a reading for you?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Hm~ hmhmhmhm~ You like it? I just made it up, hehe~

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Want me to read your palm?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Hehe, I get the feeling that something unexpected will happen if I stay here.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I'm the fortune-teller Luna. Hmmm~ Looks like our fates were interwoven at some point. Hehehe, please take good care of me then, Professor~

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: The wheel of destiny has begun to turn.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I feel it... The wisdom and mystery of the runes...

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: At last! It's the future that belongs to us!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Relax, I'll lead our team onto the right path.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Destiny, guide us forward!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: The mysterious runes shall reveal our destiny! Onward, to victory!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: I predicted this outcome!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Everything is in the palm of my hand~

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: But how... Were my predictions... off their mark...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Huh? You want to have a divination duel with me? Oh, I'm more than happy to oblige, and I'll take you on using any means you like! Hm? You predict that I'll say "I do"? What a strange prediction to make. And this little box is your divination tool... Ah... Ah, that's not fair! Ugh... You, you can't count this as a duel! 
(Sighs) Still, Professor, if you truly wish to bind us together with the red string of fate, you'd best be ready for everything that comes with it. Because no matter who we are, whether in Magrasea or reality, our fates will be interwoven and completely inseparable.
Hoho, well, since you've prepared yourself for this, then my answer is... "I do!"

voices.label: New Year
voices.text:
Happy New Year! Do you have any wishes you want to be granted during the new year? I can tell your fortune for free, you know!
Hm? You want me to retain a sense of mystery? Hoho... True, it's definitely more interesting this way. But as long as I'm around, I can help you achieve your goals for the year, no matter what they are!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Professor, this way, this way.
Hehe, as I thought, you're surrounded by beauties today. According to my predictions, if you stay by my side, noooobody will bother you! Sounds great, huh? Now then, could I trouble you to try this chocolate for me?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Qixi legends, hm... This story is often used to predict prospects in marriage, but the outcome can change depending on how it's interpreted. You can also read it as a story of a couple that can't be together, or a story of how true love overcomes all. Now then... which reading do you prefer, Professor?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Hehehe, I foresaw all these pranks a long time ago. Whether it's the statues running amok in the Oasis, or the marching band that suddenly plays by itself, no trick shall ever... work... on? Uwah! Who, who, who's that?! Pro-pro-pro-pro-professor! You did that on purpose, didn't you! Get back here!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Huh? Why are you here, Professor? Nonono, I'm no Luna, I'm just a wandering fortune-teller. Eh? My name? Oh no, I forgot to come up with a name... Ahem, in any case, I'm just a nameless fortune-teller who happens to be passing by. Dear Professor, since our encounter is a fated one, I shall give you this present... It will ward off all misfortune, so make sure you take good care of it and cherish it, okay? Aah, don't open it right away... It, it's kind of embarrassing...

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor! When performing divinations, we often use birth dates to learn about the lives of our clients and simulate their futures to clear up their doubts and confusion. But in your case, I don't even need to do a reading to be sure that no matter what sort of hardship and suffering that might come your way, people will always remember you and your life will be full of meaning. So please let me witness it to the very end.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud!

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Hm? Are you interested in my fortune-telling, Professor? These are ALL my fortune-telling tools! This tarot deck, this crystal ball... Even this ceremonial sword can help me divine the future. The truth is, rather than tools and methods, the most important thing is the bond between the diviner and the seeker, as well as sensing the premonitions of fate. Still, there are always people who say that Dolls being able to feel premonitions is way too absurd... Ehhh... but I CAN feel them!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Mm... Hm... Mm? Ah... Uwah, Professor! You scared the heck out of me... I, I wasn't spacing out. It was a divination! Hm... As I thought, the image of you in the mirror is really special; it seems to be wreathed in mist. Could this be some kind of mysterious sign? But why is it so indistinct! Aaaahhhhhh! Nonono, I need to know! Professor, sit down here, I'm going to do a proper reading on you!

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Hehehe~ Today's predictions are done. Hm? Is that you, Professor? I was just recording how I used fortune-telling to help people in my divination diary. It's a habit I've had ever since I was awoken, and as for why... Well, if you really must know, it's because I like to see the smiles on people's faces when I help solve their problems, so I want to record it down in order to never forget them! Oh yes, since opportunities like this don't come by often, is there anything bothering you, Professor? Let me help you take care of it with fortune-telling~

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Ohhh~ Welcome to the Oasis' Divination Gallery, Professor! Tadaaaah, how do you like it? It might not be very big, but it really sets the tone, right? Hm? You want to know about this framed tarot card? It symbolizes the promise Yelena and I made with each other. I once took over from her as the host of the show "The Voice of Destiny". That was a really tough period of my life; I had to report to work early to prepare for filming and I still had to maintain a good image as a TV show hostess even in my public life. Still, I was able to know and understand her better because I went through something like that. Also, the promise this tarot card represents finally came true on the cloud server.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
When I first came to the cloud server, I was worried... I was worried that I might lose my inspiration, be unable to sense the future, and lose my ability to tell fortunes. Fortune-telling isn't just a part of my base layer logic, it's also the reason for my existence. That's why I've been thinking; although my fortune-telling abilities are still fine, if my environment changes again, will I still be able to view fortune-telling the same way... Ack! Why'd you pat my head all of a sudden, Professor?!
Ehhh... Now that you've gone and done that, it feels like the mood's all gone. Still, as long as you're by my side, then even if I end up losing my way because of fortune-telling, I'm sure you'll rush to my side to help me out. Although the future I can see now is still unclear... I believe that soon enough, we'll be reunited in reality, in different personas!

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: Bingo~ ♪

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehe~

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Ehhh?!

career:
The UA-FT was a specialized fortune-telling Doll developed by Universal Anything Services. In order to ensure high prediction accuracy, the engineers installed a high-performance data processing system comparable to that of Cyber Media's A-PST(Di) and fused it with a UAS proprietary fortune-telling module. During testing, the UA-FT showed a prediction accuracy rate of 90%. What made the UA-FT special was that it wasn't a wholly new design but an expansion of an existing general-purpose Doll model.
In contrast to the designation of UA-FT, the name Luna was more widely-known. According to her CV, Luna once ran "philosophy halls" in various cities and once served as both hostess and diviner of the popular fortune-telling show "The Voice of Destiny". Her reason for joining Project Neural Cloud was a vague "I want a different fortune-telling experience". However, insiders claimed that UAS had intentions regarding Luna.
infoStories:
Although designing a Doll capable of fortune-telling did not meet the needs of the mass market, many companies noticed the potential of the field during the early days of Doll technology—with the combination of science and pseudoscience as a gimmick, popularity could be gained and thus improve the company's reputation. However, the process of developing a fortune-telling Doll was fraught with difficulty, with problems ranging from Dolls not understanding the meaning of fortune-telling, or the accuracy of said fortune-telling being so poor that it couldn't even qualify as a selling point. For instance, Cyber Media's A-PST(Di) hostess Doll was preloaded with fortune-telling knowledge, but it still could not solve the conundrum of how to enable a Doll to make accurate and effective predictions in response to real-life examples. UAS, a latecomer to this particular race, released the UA-FT and changed the market direction just as the other companies ran out of ideas.
The UA-FT's body was essentially copied wholesale from a certain generic Doll model developed by UAS. According to press releases by UAS, the choice of this Doll model was because it could experience a form of "intuition" and carry out effective fortune-telling in response to it. That said, most people thought it was nothing more than marketing speak to sell their product. However, after UA-FT managed to accurately divine the location of a lost child, people began to realize that perhaps its fortune-telling ability was more than just a gimmick.

Although UAS claimed that the UA-FT was developed from the template of a generic Doll, the results of the UA-FT's "checkup" after joining Project Neural Cloud indicated that some of her parts were not available on the mass market, and her body showed signs of large-scale modification and extensive repairs. However, the UA-FT remained tight-lipped about her past, and information regarding this topic was also one of the most highly-classified parts of the UA-FT project. The sole clue to her past came from an interview where she mentioned that the name "Luna" was coined by a friend who got her interested in fortune-telling. Luna had a complex expression on her face when the topic came up, which only served to add more mystery to her past.

Ever since Luna began to enter the public spotlight, much of her time was spent running her fortune-telling gallery, otherwise known as the "Philosophy Hall". It provided fortune-telling services using tools such as tarot cards, runestones, crystal balls, and many others. Her superlative fortune-telling skills, as well as her beautiful, enigmatic, yet personable image soon became the subject of much conversation. An endless stream of callers came to visit, and some members of the upper strata even took notice of her. After having to drive off several over-enthusiastic streamers, Luna put up a sign reading "No Interviews Or Streams" at her Philosophy Hall, and her social media accounts were set to "private".
Six months later, the renowned TV show "The Voice of Destiny" invited Luna to join them in recording an episode, which was where she came to know the show's host, Yelena. Insiders revealed that their initial interaction was not a happy one, and they even engaged in a fortune-telling duel behind the scenes. Half a month later, Luna's social media accounts were updated to reflect that she became the hostess of "The Voice of Destiny", and she began to take Yelena's place as the show's host. This led many fans to speculate on the relationship between the two of them and the truth behind that divination duel of theirs.

After awakening in the cloud server, Luna found herself in a certain Burbank back alley and thought 42Lab's staff had dumped her near her home, at least until she saw a huge ruckus that arose near one of the sector's theaters. That was when she realized where she had truly ended up. She returned to her old trade as she wandered through Burbank and gathered useful information. However, Luna found that her fortune-telling abilities had grown tremendously unstable and highly erroneous, to the point where some agents mistook her for a charlatan.
Just as Luna was nearing the end of her rope, a certain Doll assigned to Burbank for a dispatch assignment met her and brought her back to the Oasis for a full checkup. The conclusion was that Luna's neural cloud had been damaged and only the collection of her neural fragments, which had been scattered throughout Magrasea, could help restore and repair it. This process would take a long time, but Luna was determined to go through with it.

Once Luna recovered her lost neural fragments and repaired her neural cloud, Yelena came to her with a proposition and the two of them decided to establish the Oasis' Fortune-Telling Emporium. Although the two of them hadn't had much contact ever since Yelena left "The Voice Of Destiny", they showed a startling level of coordination after their fortune-telling led them to the Oasis. Almost every day saw the two of them using their fortune-telling skills to help other agents.
In addition to fortune-telling, Luna's personal hobbies also covered a dizzying variety of interests, including but not limited to esoteric occult texts, collecting exquisite tools, and various other items. As one of the two proprietors of the Oasis' Fortune-Telling Emporium, Luna filled the premises with her collection. In response, Yelena commented, "You'll never know what kind of strange and exotic item she'll pull out of her hood or from somewhere in her room. Of course, the most amazing thing is how she knows exactly where everything is."
oathDesc: Our encounter was ordained by destiny.

projections.name: Sensing The Source
projections.desc:
Attire produced with a Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Does it seem very mysterious? Sometimes, the more mysterious a thing is, the easier it is to understand."

"Does it seem very mysterious? Sometimes, the more mysterious a thing is, the easier it is to understand."

projections.name: Clear As A Spring
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with a Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"I am the journey's end, the riddle's answer, and the far shore. Look at me—Do you see yourself clearly now?"

skinList.name: Moon In Blue
skinList.desc:
The "Gala Dreams" series—Countless colors weave together to create resplendent dreams on this memorable evening ball, which slowly blends into the shades of the night.
The flowers bloom in silence, occupying a corner off to the side, where they reflect the radiance of the moon. Drawn by the guidance of the light, you find your fated person there.
"Hehe, fate has guided you to this encounter. The night is long; are you ready to dance with me?"
